tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get your WebToAppConvert account info: tier (free/paid/subscribed), credit balance (rollover + monthly), and per-tier limits (max apps, max signing keys, artifact retention). Always call this before triggering a build to verify sufficient credits.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List the user's apps with status and last build info. Use cursor for pagination.

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Get full configuration for a specific app by its siteId.

tools.name: update_app
tools.description: Update app configuration fields. Only fields included in the patch are changed. tools.name: duplicate_app
tools.description: Duplicate an existing app — copies all config, icon, splash, intro screens, and signing references to a new app. Build state resets. New app name gets a "(Copy)" suffix; use update_app to rename. Useful when several apps share one configured template; for a single new app use create_app.

tools.name: create_app
tools.description: Create a new Android app from a website. Required: name, url (https), packageName (e.g. com.example.app). Colors and version are optional (dashboard defaults). tools.description: Replace an app's icon, round icon or splash image. MCP cannot carry files, so this returns a single-use upload URL (valid 15 minutes) and a ready curl command. tools.description: Permanently delete an app and all of its builds, including their download files. This cannot be undone through the API, so only call it when the user has clearly asked to delete this specific app; confirm the app name with get_app first. Requires confirm: true. tools.description: One-shot build status check. Returns status, queue position, estimated wait time, and build log entries. Use estimatedWaitSeconds from the response to pace the next check. tools.description: Check a build and wait up to ~25 seconds for it to finish. If still running after 25 seconds, returns current status and instructs you to call wait_for_build again — keep calling it until you get a terminal result (completed or failed). tools.name: get_download_url
tools.description: Get a fresh 15-minute download URL for a completed build artifact (APK or AAB zip). Returns 409 if build is not yet complete; 410 if the artifact retention period has expired.

tools.name: list_builds
tools.description: List builds, optionally filtered by app. Paginated.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_download_url · Private data: request_asset_upload, delete_app, list_signing_keys, generate_signing_key · Public sink: duplicate_app, request_asset_upload · Destructive: create_app, request_asset_upload, delete_app.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_download_url · Private data: request_asset_upload, delete_app, list_signing_keys, generate_signing_key · Public sink: duplicate_app, request_asset_upload · Destructive: create_app, request_asset_upload, delete_app

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
